raw_evidence_cards.document_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: The paper proposes a comprehensive survey on graph summarization techniques that rely on graph neural networks (GNNs). It reviews current state-of-the-art approaches and discusses new research areas like graph reinforcement learning.
differences: does not introduce a new model like GSAERU
focuses on surveying existing techniques rather than proposing a novel solution

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
sources.quote: In the past, most graph summarization techniques sought to capture the most important part of a graph statistically. However, today, the high dimensionality and complexity of modern graph data are making deep learning techniques more popular.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
sources.quote: Additionally, the survey provides details of benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, and open-source tools that are often employed in experimentation settings, along with a detailed comparison, discussion, and takeaways for the research community focused on graph summarization.

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Utilized graph summarization techniques to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource usage.
overlaps: Generated multiple smaller subgraphs from the large-scale graph
Performed model training on these subgraphs
The subgraphs generated by graph summarization were much smaller than the original graph

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Summarization with Graph Neural Networks
sources.quote: In the past, most graph summarization techniques sought to capture the most important part of a graph statistically. However, today, the high dimensionality and complexity of modern graph data are making deep learning techniques more popular. Hence, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of progress in deep learning summarization techniques that rely on graph neural networks (GNNs).

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposed a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP.
differences: zero-shot generalization to instances of any size

sources.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
sources.quote: In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP.
